rooms.15102: Kigrint's hut is a single low room of driftwood planks and tarred sailcloth, hung all over with knotted nets and strings of dried sprats. The floor is packed sand scattered with fish bones and shell cups, and a clay lamp burns with a smoky, oily flame. Sleeping mats lie rolled against the curved wall, and the whole place smells of brine and old smoke. The only door opens south onto the Sandy Path, letting in a thin stripe of salt air.
rooms.15109: Pale sand lies drifted across the path, soft underfoot and speckled with broken shells. Palms lean overhead, rattling their fronds in the sea wind, and a line of gutted fish hangs drying between two trunks. A driftwood hut stands to the north with its door ajar to the weather. The path runs east toward the Dirt Path and falls away west to the open Shore, where the surf can be heard hissing on the beach.
rooms.15110: The sand gives way here to hard-packed brown dirt, rutted by hand carts and bare, clawed feet. Squat palms thin out, and a rack of split fish cooks in the sun beside the track, buzzing with flies. Someone has scratched crude wavy marks into a stump to claim the rack. The path leads west back toward the Sandy Path and on east to the Worn Path.
rooms.15111: The path is trodden into a shallow trench here, polished smooth by years of traffic. A warm smell of baking bread drifts from a doorway to the north, mixing with the oily tang of a whetstone from the low building to the south. Strings of dried fish and bright gull feathers sway from the eaves. The Worn Path goes on east, and the Dirt Path lies back to the west.
rooms.15103: A squat clay oven fills one end of the bakery, its mouth glowing orange and breathing out heat. Flat loaves of seaweed bread and sticky buns of crushed nuts cool on racks along the sooty walls, and flour dusts every plank of the counter. The air is thick and sweet, with a bitter edge of burnt crust. The only way out is south, back to the Worn Path.
rooms.15112: The path widens into a rough crossing where several ways meet. Loud voices and the thump of a drum spill from a stout door to the east, and a row of pegs along a wall is hung with dripping silver fish. A faded track leads north toward the Untravelled Path, while the way south becomes the Well Worn Path. To the west the trodden road returns to another stretch of the Worn Path.
rooms.15104: Weeds have crept across this track, and the few footprints in the sand are old and half blown away. Thorny sea-buckthorn crowds the edges, heavy with orange berries. Ahead to the north the great bronze gate of Kyor'Glt stands open now, its blue-green leaves swung back on stiff hinges so that the dock beyond can be seen. The path leads south to the Worn Path and the town.
rooms.15113: The tavern is a low, smoky room of sticky tables and upturned barrels for stools, lit by lamps of fish oil that gutter and stink. A long plank bar runs along one wall, scarred with a hundred knife-carved marks and slopped with pale seaweed ale. Rough songs and louder arguments seem to soak into the beams overhead. A stout door leads west to the Worn Path, and an archway opens east into the Brawler's Room.
rooms.15114: Sand has been strewn thick on the floor of this room to soak up spilled blood and ale, and it is trodden into a dark crust. A ring of rope hangs slack between four posts at the centre, and the benches around it are cracked and splintered. Old gouges mark the plank walls at the height of a goblin's head. The tavern lies back to the west, and a door to the north leads into a storage room.
rooms.15105: Crates and barrels crowd the storage room to the rafters, stacked with salted fish, tallow and coils of tarred rope. Sacks of grey sea-salt lean against the wall and spill a crust of white onto the floor. A single slit high up lets in a blade of light, thick with drifting dust. The only door leads south, back to the Brawler's Room.
rooms.15120: The path here has been worn down into a groove, deeper than a boot, by countless trips from the town to the water. A stone-ringed well stands to one side, its rope frayed and its bucket hanging from a bent iron hook. North lies the busy crossing of the Worn Path, and the path goes on east toward the Littered Path. A heavy door to the south leads into the Armory.
rooms.15121: Rubbish piles up along both edges of the path: fish heads, cracked pots, rags stiff with grease and gnawed bones. A cloud of flies rises and settles with every step. The trodden dirt bends away south toward the Ruined Path, while the way back west leads to the Well Worn Path. A single palm survives, its trunk stained with years of thrown slops.
rooms.15130: Broken walls of old stone stand along the path, the remains of huts whose roofs fell in long ago. Young palms have rooted in the rubble, and lizards bask on the tumbled blocks. A path goes north toward the Littered Path and another winds south to a turn. To the east the faint sound of dripping water draws the eye to a damp patch of green.
rooms.15131: A thin rill of fresh water trickles from a crack in a mossy boulder and spreads across the path in a bright, shallow fan. Ferns and green slime cling to the stones, a welcome softness in this dry place. The mud is stamped with the prints of many feet that come here to fill jars. The path leads north toward another stretch of the Littered Path, and west to the Ruined Path.
rooms.15122: Scraps and shells are ground into the mud here, carried down from the trickle of water nearby. A broken amphora lies half buried, its neck sticking up like a gravestone. Beetles scuttle through the litter, and a cracked bucket serves as a sign that someone once tried to tidy up. The way east leads on to the Muddy Path, and the trickle of water lies to the south.
rooms.15123: The path has dissolved into a sticky brown mire of mud, studded with flat stones and rotting planks laid down as stepping places. The air is heavy with the sour reek of wet earth and seaweed. A pair of palms bend over the track, their fronds dripping. The way leads west to the Littered Path and east to a turn in the path.
rooms.15124: Four ways meet at a bend in the path, hemmed in by palms and the walls of two huts. The doors of the northern hut and of the one to the east are both made of lashed driftwood, painted with crude spirals and fish. A line of washing, grey with salt, snaps in the breeze. The path narrows to the south, and the Muddy Path runs back west.
rooms.15115: The Eflykt hut is cramped and tidy, its walls lined with shelves of whelk shells, bundles of herbs and little carved fish. A mat of woven reeds covers the sand floor, and a battered cooking pot hangs over a cold fire pit. The light that finds its way in is dim and brown, filtered through patched sailcloth. The door leads south onto the turn in the path.
rooms.15125: The Gafftl hut smells of tar and wet wool, with a heap of mended nets in one corner and a half-built boat rib propped against the wall. A single stool stands by a table scarred with knife cuts, and an old bronze cleaver is nailed above the door as a charm. The roof is thatch black with smoke. The door leads west back onto the turn in the path.
rooms.15132: The path squeezes tight here between a wall of rock and a thicket of palms. Roots break the ground and tangle the way, and the sea wind that has followed the track so far dies away. North lies the bend in the path with its two huts. Ahead to the south the trees rise taller and darker, and the track leads on into the forest.
rooms.15139: Tall trees press close on either side, their trunks furred with moss and their crowns tangled overhead into a green roof. A thin trail of trodden leaf mould winds on between the roots. Birds call somewhere high up, and the air smells of damp bark. North the trail leads back toward the Path Narrows, and south it sinks into a dimmer wood.
rooms.15141: Little light reaches the ground in this part of the forest. Thick creepers hang from the boughs like slack ropes, and pale fungus grows in rings around the rotting stumps. The trail is hard to follow and often vanishes under drifts of dead leaves. It leads north toward the Forest and south to the Murky Woods.
rooms.15149: Grey, sour-smelling mud lies between the trunks here, and thin mist clings to the knees of the trees. The wood is quiet except for the slow drip of water from the branches. Trails run in three directions: north back toward the Dim Forest, east to a few bare trees, and south into the Dank Woods. A rotted signpost leans at the crossing, its lettering long since washed away.
rooms.15150: A handful of dead trees stand in a clearing, bone-white and stripped of bark, their bare branches clawing at the sky. Nothing else grows on the hard-packed earth. West, the murky woods close in again. To the east a squat fortress of rough black stone fills the way, with a heavy door set in its face and a rusted lantern hanging above it.
rooms.15151: The Guarded Hall is a broad stone chamber with a smoke-blackened ceiling and a floor of worn flags. Torches burn in iron brackets and throw wavering shadows over racks of spears and a rough table scattered with dice. The door to the west leads out to the dead trees. A dark hallway runs east, and a doorway to the south opens on the guard room.
rooms.15152: The hallway is narrow and gloomy, its walls sweating with damp and lit only by a single guttering torch. The flags underfoot are worn into shallow dips, and the air smells of cold ash. Back west the light of the Guarded Hall can be seen. The hallway goes north to the Apprentice Chambers and south into a still darker passage.
rooms.15142: This chamber has the cramped look of a student's quarters, with straw pallets along the wall and a table piled with cracked slates and dripping candle stubs. Scraps of coloured chalk lie scattered, and half-erased circles are scratched into the floor. A faint scorched smell hangs in the air. A narrow door in the east wall leads to a storage room, and the hall lies to the south.
rooms.15143: Shelves of dusty jars and bundles of dried roots line the walls of this closet, labelled in a crabbed, childish hand. A cracked mortar sits in one corner next to a broom with half its bristles gone. The air is stale and tastes of old herbs. The only way out is west, back to the Apprentice Chambers.
rooms.15164: Here the hallway grows darker still, and the torches have been left to burn down to cold black stubs in their brackets. The floor is gritty with sand and the ceiling is lost in shadow. A draught carries the smell of oil and singed hair. The passage goes north to the Dark Hallway, turns east along another dark stretch, and drops south into a workshop.
rooms.15165: The passage bends here, the walls close enough to brush with both elbows. Soot streaks the stone above every bracket, though no torch burns in them now. Water has seeped through the ceiling and left a pale crust of salt on the floor. A dark hallway runs back west, and the passage turns south toward a wider space.
rooms.15174: A draught whines along this stretch of hallway, stirring cobwebs that hang in long grey ropes from the roof. The flagstones are cracked and scored with the marks of dragged crates. A sharp, hot smell like a forge comes from somewhere ahead. The hall runs north to a bend, west to the Apprentice Workshop, and south into a larger chamber.
rooms.15182: The walls of this chamber are carved with the coils of a great scaled beast, worked in black stone that glints like wet slate. A hoard bowl of beaten bronze, long since emptied, stands in the middle of the floor. The air is warm and carries an old scent of smoke and cinders. A passage leads north, and a narrow stair of black steps winds up into the dark.
rooms.15183: The stair ends in a long hall of rough-hewn stone, whose roof is held up by pillars carved into the shapes of kneeling prisoners. Banners of tattered hide hang between them, painted with the crude red sign of Morvoct. Smoke from a trough of burning fat clings under the ceiling and stings the eyes. The hall stretches north, and the stair winds down behind you.
rooms.15177: Trophies cover the walls of this section of the hall: dented helms, notched swords and shields pierced by spears, each with a scrap of cloth nailed beneath as a tally of the beaten. A broad trough of embers glows down the middle, giving the pillars a sullen red cast. Hall continues both north and south of here. A heavy door in the west wall is barred with an iron rod and leads to a place of cages.
rooms.15168: The northern end of the hall is a broad flagged floor, scuffed bright by many marching feet. Pillars stand in pairs, and between them hang rows of grey skulls strung on cord that click softly in the draught. A great oak door in the north wall is studded with bronze nails. To the west an arch gives onto a green and fragrant room, and the hall runs back south.
rooms.15156: The Great Hall rises high into shadow, its beams black with centuries of smoke. A long table of single-plank oak runs the whole length of the floor, scored by knives and stained with spilled drink. Tall chairs of whalebone stand at the head, facing a hearth big enough to roast an ox. The door lies south, and a ladder of rusted iron climbs down through a hole in the floor.
rooms.15153: A cold white mist fills this round chamber, rising from cracks in the floor and curling around your knees. The stone walls drip, and sound is swallowed by the fog so that even breathing seems far away. Faint patterns of light drift in the vapour as if something moved just beyond sight. The ladder is the only way out, leading up.
rooms.15167: Rows of herbs grow in raised troughs of stone, tended under a lattice of glowing fungus that lights the room with a pale green gleam. Bitter wormwood, sea-kale and pungent garlic mix their scents in the damp air. The soil is black and freshly turned, and a bone-handled trowel is stuck upright in it. The hall lies east, and a dark doorway opens west.
rooms.15166: Deep shadow pools in every corner of this chamber, as thick as spilled ink, and the single weak lamp seems to make it darker rather than brighter. The walls are bare and cold, and the floor is scattered with old feathers and dust. A whisper of cold air stirs from a gap in the stonework to the north. A passage leads east back toward the herb garden.
rooms.15154: A secret way, scarcely wider than a barrel, twists through the thickness of the wall here. Cobwebs and grit cling to the roughly chiselled stone, and the smell of dust is strong. The tunnel bends away east along a faintly sloping floor. The way south opens back into a shadowy room.
rooms.15155: The tunnel zigzags between close walls, scratched with tally marks and half-faded runes. Water drips with a slow, steady beat from somewhere overhead, and the air is cold and tastes of rust. The passage runs north to a further stretch and west to the bend behind you. Shallow footprints are pressed into the grey dust.
rooms.15144: A last stretch of narrow passage ends in a low arch, beyond which the smell of incense and old blood is strong. The stone here is smoother and carefully fitted, as if made for someone's pride. A thin line of torchlight glimmers to the east. The tunnel leads back south.
rooms.15145: Morvoct's Inner Sanctum is a small round chamber with a domed roof, hung with black cloth and lit by a ring of fat red candles. In the centre stands a stone chair carved with leering faces, with a pile of stolen furs heaped at its foot. Gold coins and rusted crowns are pushed into the corners as if forgotten. The only way out is the passage west.
rooms.15176: Iron cages line the walls of this room, their bars bent and their floors thick with straw and bones. Chains hang from rings in the stone, and a heavy musk of animals and rot hangs in the air. Claw marks are cut deep into the doorframe. The hall lies east, and a low door in the opposite wall leads on west.
rooms.15175: A cold chamber of black stone, stained dark in patterns beneath the rack and the wheel. Hooks and iron tongs hang in rows from the walls, and manacles hang from a ring in the ceiling. Old rust-brown splashes cover the floor around a drain. The only way out is east, through the room of cages.
rooms.15173: Benches and workbenches fill this workshop, heaped with blackened tongs, cracked crucibles and bits of scrap metal. A forge of rough brick squats against one wall, ash heaped about its grate and a pair of leather bellows dangling beside it. The floor is gritty with filings and half-melted wax. A hallway leads north, and a narrow opening leads east to another passage.
rooms.15163: A small stone room, hung with weapons and stinking of damp leather and old sweat. A table with a rack of cudgels and a pot of cold broth stands in the middle, and sleeping pallets lie along the wall. A ring of keys dangles from a nail by the door. The hall lies north, and a heavy door, banded in iron, leads south.
rooms.15172: The prison is a low cellar divided by rusty bars into narrow cells. Straw rots in the corners, and iron rings are bolted to the walls at the height of a wrist. A pitiful scratch of tally marks climbs one wall. The air is cold and damp, and water drips from a crack in the ceiling. The only way out is north, through the guard room.
rooms.15162: The woods are heavy here, sagging with wet and reeking of rotted leaves. Fat toadstools crowd the trunks, and the ground gives under each footstep. Somewhere to the west is the steady roar of falling water. A trail leads north to the Murky Woods and west toward the sound of the water.
rooms.15161: A thin white waterfall tumbles down a black rock face into a pool that foams and steams in the cool air. Spray drifts across the path and soaks everything with a cold dew. Slick stones form a rough ford at the edge. The trail leads east back into the Dank Woods and climbs west to a heap of broken rock.
rooms.15160: Great slabs of fallen stone lie heaped in a tumbled pile, as if some mountain had shrugged them off. Small ferns grow in the gaps, and the rocks are slick underfoot. The roar of the falls lies to the east. A narrow trail climbs north to a hollow, and a steeper way drops south toward a cliff.
rooms.15148: The ground here dips into a hollow, a round bowl in the hillside lined with soft moss and ringed by gnarled thorn bushes. The air is still and warm, sheltered from every wind. An old fire pit lies cold near the middle, its stones black. A path leads south to the rock pile and west into a clearing.
rooms.15147: A grassy clearing opens in the scrub, bright with sun and humming with bees. A ring of white stones, half sunk in the turf, marks where something once stood. Gnats drift in clouds above the long grass. The clearing runs east to a hollow and west to a rocky height.
rooms.15146: The ground here climbs to a bare plateau of grey rock, scoured by wind and dotted with tufts of salt grass. A great view opens over the green tops of the forest and out to the far glitter of the sea. The rock is cracked and splintered, and gulls wheel high above it. A path leads east down to a clearing, and a rough stair of stone leads south to a porch.
rooms.15159: A porch of huge rough-cut stones juts from the rock face, roofed by an overhanging ledge that keeps off the weather. Bones of large animals are piled neatly along its edge, and a pole stands by the entrance hung with scraps of pelt. The stone beneath is worn smooth by one heavy tread. A path leads north up to the plateau, and a massive door to the west opens into a den.
rooms.15158: The den is a huge round chamber hacked out of the living rock, with a ceiling lost in smoke. A bed of heaped hides lies against one wall, big enough for three goblins to sleep in, and a gnawed ox-leg is propped beside it. A giant stool and table stand to the south near the glow of a fire, and wooden pens occupy the west. The door east leads to the porch.
rooms.15170: A great fire burns in a ring of boulders here, filling the den with a ruddy glow and a thick smell of roasting meat. Skins are pegged to the rock around it to dry, and a huge iron pot hangs from a beam of black timber. The floor is warm and covered in ash. The den lies north, and a dim corner lies to the west.
rooms.15169: In the dimmest corner of the den, shadows pool around heaps of rubbish, discarded bones and the ragged leftovers of meals. A cracked clay jar the size of a barrel holds rainwater, scummed green on top. The smell is rank, a mix of old fat and wet fur. Light from the fire glows to the east, and the animal pens lie north.
rooms.15157: Rough pens of lashed timber and thorn branches fill this end of the den, their gates tied shut with knotted hide. Trampled dung and chewed straw cover the floor, and the sharp smell of beasts is overpowering. Scratch marks and a few tufts of coarse hair cling to the posts. The big den lies east, and a gap in the fence leads south to a dim corner.
rooms.15171: The trail drops onto a narrow ledge along a steep cliff of crumbling yellow stone. Far below, the sea heaves and bursts white against rocks, and the wind tugs hard at your clothes. Droppings streak the stone and long grey feathers cling in the cracks. A rough track leads north to a pile of rock, while the ledge winds south around the face toward a nest.
rooms.15181: The cliff ledge widens here into a rough platform littered with sticks, bones and shreds of cloth. Shrill cries echo off the rock, and the stench of old fish and droppings stings the nose. The sea is a long way below, and gulls ride the updraughts. A path runs north back along the ledge, and a gap in the cliff leads west toward a perch.
rooms.15180: A broad shelf of rock juts out over the drop like a landing stage, scraped bare and slimed with white droppings. Great curved claw-marks gouge the stone near the lip. The wind is fierce and smells of salt and rot, and tufts of feather skitter across the floor. The ledge leads east back to the nest's entrance, and a dark opening in the cliff leads west into a hallway.
rooms.15179: This hallway is hacked into the cliff, its walls rough and streaked with smoke and bird lime. A bundle of reeds burns in a holder, sputtering and sending uneven light along the ceiling. Bones and feathers crunch underfoot. The perch lies east in the wind, a smell of cooking comes from a doorway south, and a barred opening to the west leads to a cage.
rooms.15184: The kitchen is a ragged cave of smoke-blackened stone, with a stone slab for a table and a firepit crowded with iron pots. Hooks hang from the ceiling, and a few dried scraps of meat dangle from them. The floor is greasy and spattered with old stains. The hallway lies north, and the din of a dining hall comes through an arch to the east.
rooms.15185: The dining hall is a long rough chamber crowded with benches knocked together from driftwood and wrecked ship's timber. Bone-white plates and cups lie scattered over a table stained with years of spills. A stale reek of fish, wine and old bones fills the air. The kitchen lies to the west, and a floor of piled straw begins to the east.
rooms.15186: Mounds of dry straw cover the floor, matted down into dozens of hollows where sleepers have curled. Feathers, bones and bright stolen trinkets are pressed into the straw, and the air is thick with dust that tickles the throat. A crude ladder of lashed branches climbs to a higher ledge. The dining hall lies west and the nest of the queen rises up above.
rooms.15187: The queen's nest is a huge bowl of woven branches, bones and sailcloth, perched on a ledge at the top of the cliff. The wind howls through the weave, and a layer of soft grey down covers the floor. Shiny things are scattered around the rim: buckles, coins, a cracked mirror, and a shattered ship's bell. The only way back is down the ladder.
rooms.15178: A heavy cage of lashed bone and driftwood stands in this alcove, too small to stand in, with a floor smeared with filth and fish scales. Gnawed leg-bones are heaped in a corner, and the bars are scratched with tally marks. A cold draught blows through the gaps. The only way out is east, back to the hallway.
rooms.15138: The path swings round a stand of fat palms, and the sand underfoot turns pale and fine again. A cool breeze brings the smell of the sea and of tar from somewhere ahead. Crabs have left a lacework of tiny tracks across the dune. The path leads north toward the Ruined Path and west under a canopy of palm fronds.
rooms.15137: Palms of every height crowd the path here, their fronds knotting into a swaying green tunnel. Coconuts lie among the leaves and fibrous husks are heaped up in drifts. A string of shells hangs from a branch and chimes in the breeze. The trodden sand leads east to the turn in the path and west to the next stretch of palms.
rooms.15136: The sand is smooth here, swept clean by broom and by wind, and the palms stand in a tidy row on each side. Flags of bright cloth snap from poles, and a ring of whitewashed stones marks the approach to a large hut. A broad door to the west is carved with a crude sunburst. The path runs east back through the palms.
rooms.15135: Chief Gralkt's hut is the largest in the town, a long room of timber and thatch hung with trophies from the sea: harpoons, ships' lanterns, painted figureheads and a great jawbone over the door. A heap of cushions made of sailcloth is laid before a low table crowded with maps. Smoke from a whale-oil lamp makes the ceiling shine. The door leads east to the Palm Covered Path.
rooms.15129: Racks of battered shields, dented helms and boiled-hide jerkins line the walls of the armory, each one tagged with a knotted cord. A bench in the middle is heaped with straps, buckles and clinking rings of mail. The air smells of oil and leather, and the floor is gritty with rust. The only door leads north onto the Well Worn Path.
rooms.15119: Cutlasses, boarding axes and spears fill the racks inside this rough forge-shop, and the long counter is notched where blades have been tested. A whetstone wheel stands in the corner, wet and gleaming, with a pile of sparks scorched into the floor beneath. Everything smells of hot iron and fish oil. A wide opening leads north to the Worn Path.

15108.description: The beach is a long crescent of grey shingle and dark sand, strewn with wrack and the bleached ribs of wrecked boats. Gulls scream over a tangle of kelp that heaves in the shallows, and the surf pounds with a steady roar. A wooden raft is drawn up on the pebbles. The path leads east to the Sandy Path, while the water begins south and west among the thick weed.

rooms.15118: You drift on a battered raft in dark green water, with great ribbons of kelp rising on every side like the pillars of a drowned hall. Silt hangs in the swell and pale fish flicker in and out of the weeds. The beach lies close to the north. A round door of corroded bronze stands in a wall of black rock to the south, and the weed thins to ruined stonework to the west.
rooms.15128: The raft bumps against a towering wall of dark coral and barnacled stone, its surface carved with the faces of tritons. A great arched door of pearl-inlaid bronze stands in the wall to the south, ajar above the waterline. Lamps of cold blue light glow in niches either side. The water behind you leads north into the weeds.
rooms.15134: The Waiting Room is a dry vaulted hall deep in the fortress, with walls of polished coral and a floor of mother-of-pearl that shimmers in the dim blue light. Benches of whalebone line the sides, carved with waves and shells. The air is cool and tastes of salt. A great door of carved shell opens south on the throne room, an archway of water leads west into a flooded court, and the entrance lies north.
rooms.15140: The throne room of the Sea King is a vast domed chamber of pearl and blue glass, in which pale light ripples across the walls like water. A throne of twisted coral stands upon a dais of nacre, flanked by tall columns wound with golden chains. Scattered shells and pearls glitter in the gloom. The only way out is the door north.
rooms.15133: You float in the flooded Noble's Court, a ring of drowned colonnades whose pillars are furred with weed and carved with stately sea-folk. Shafts of dim blue light fall through gaps in the ceiling and shiver on the water. A bell somewhere deep sounds slow and mournful. The only way on is east, to the dry hall.
rooms.15117: Ruined arches and half-toppled walls loom out of the green gloom around your raft, crusted with barnacles and drifting with weed. Broken columns lie jumbled on the seabed below, and the carved faces on them are worn blank by the tide. Currents pull gently toward each point of the compass. Open water lies in every direction: kelp to the north, a thicker forest of weed to the east, a dark hulk to the south and a murky deep to the west.
rooms.15107: Your raft drifts among thick brown stems of kelp that rise from the depths and tangle on the surface into floating mats. The swell lifts and lowers you in slow rhythm, and the creak of the weed is almost like speech. The beach shows through the stems to the east. The kelp grows deeper west, and old ruined stones show dim beneath you toward the south.
rooms.15106: The seaweed grows so thick and tall here that it closes over the raft like a green forest, and you pole blindly through twisting aisles of kelp. Light falls in soft shafts and the water is warm and heavy. Every turn seems to lead back to the same tangled place, whichever way the current tugs. The weed thins east, and a cold pull draws toward the south.
rooms.15116: The water has turned cloudy and green, thick with silt and the fine white dust of drowned things, and you can see no further than the end of your raft. The swell is slow and oily, and the weed hangs in the murk like drowned hair. The current drags to the south toward deeper dark. North, the kelp grows thicker, and to the east lies a heap of ancient stone.
rooms.15126: Davy Jones' Locker is the blackest, deepest water in all this sea, where the raft turns in a slow cold whirl. Silver bubbles rise from the depths and burst at the surface, and the swell breathes up and down with the weight of an unseen current. Drowned masts and scraps of rope drift past in the dark. The only way back is north, through cloudy water.
rooms.15127: The black hulk of a sunken ship lies on its side beneath you, its masts snapped and its rail hung with weed and shells. Your raft rubs the green timbers of the keel, and the swell laps through a ragged hole in the hull. A drowned figurehead stares up at the surface with empty eyes. The water leads north to the ruins.

15112.description: The pegs are polished by use, each one hung with a gutted fish, and drips from them have worn a dark patch into the wall planks.

15104.description: The bronze leaves are carved with round-eyed fish faces and stand wide open on their hinges, green with age.

15177.description: Each trophy carries a scrap of cloth in a different colour, the livery of some company or town that learned too late what Morvoct's goblins can do.

15182.description: The bronze bowl is wide enough to bathe in, dented and blackened, and the floor around it is scorched in a perfect ring.

15187.description: The bronze bell is split down one side and green with age. A ship's name is still faintly legible around its rim, but the rest has long since worn away.

15135.description: The jawbone belongs to some huge sea beast, bleached white, and the teeth in it are the length of a hand.

creatures.long_desc: A salt-stained goblin shuffles past, humming a rough song and carrying a basket of fish.
creatures.description: This goblin has a leathery green hide, long drooping ears and a wide, toothy grin. His clothes are patched sailcloth, and he smells strongly of tar and herring.

creatures.long_desc: A scarred goblin warrior stands here with a cutlass in his fist, eyeing you for trouble.
creatures.description: A broad-shouldered goblin in boiled-hide armour, his green face crossed with old scars. His eyes are small and sly, and he fingers the hilt of his blade as though itching for a quarrel.

creatures.long_desc: A giant crab clacks its pincers at you from a mat of floating kelp.
creatures.description: Its shell is as wide as a shield, mottled green and brown and crusted with barnacles. Two huge pincers snap in the water, and its stalked eyes follow every movement.

creatures.long_desc: A fierce harpy matron perches here with her talons flexed and her feathers bristling.
creatures.description: The harpy has the body of a vulture and the wrinkled, furious face of an old woman. Her talons are curved like sickles, and her shriek could crack stone.

creatures.long_desc: A merman guard in a coral breastplate floats here, his trident held steady.
creatures.description: His upper body is armoured in scales of polished shell, and his lower body is a thick silvery fish tail. He holds a barbed trident as long as a boat-hook and watches you with cold, round eyes.
rooms: The Throne Room Of The Sea King

creatures.long_desc: Brogg Oneye, the cyclops, squats here, his single great eye glaring from beneath a ridge of brow.
creatures.description: A towering giant with a rough grey hide and one huge yellow eye in the middle of his forehead. He grips a club made from a ship's mast, scarred and spiked with nails.

creatures.long_desc: Morvoct, the goblin warlord, stands among his trophies, a huge axe resting on his shoulder.
creatures.description: Morvoct is the biggest goblin you have ever seen, half again as tall as the rest, with a hide the colour of old moss and eyes like polished amber. He is draped in furs and chains of stolen gold, and the crown on his brow is a dented helm of bronze.

items.room_desc: A chipped goblin cutlass lies here.
items.description: A short curved blade of cheap iron, nicked along its edge and bound at the hilt with fishing line. It is crude, but it has seen plenty of fights.

items.room_desc: A crab-shell buckler has been left here.
items.description: The domed carapace of a giant crab, strapped with leather and polished to a dull gleam. It is light, tough and smells faintly of the sea.
A perfect pearl the size of a plum, glowing with a soft inner light. Merchants in Port Halyon would pay a fortune for it.

items.room_desc: A massive club made from a ship's mast lies here.
items.description: A great maul carved from a broken mast and studded with iron nails. It is heavy enough to stagger anyone not built like a giant.

items.short_desc: the dented bronze crown of Morvoct
items.room_desc: A dented bronze crown lies here.
items.description: A battered bronze helm worn as a crown, set with chips of blue glass and pearls prised from the wrecks of a hundred ships. A lingering scent of brine clings to it.
